claims.value: Cohere Labs Tiny Aya is an open weights research release of a pretrained 3.35 billion parameter model optimized for efficient, strong, and balanced multilingual representation across 70+ languages, including many lower-resourced ones. It is designed to support downstream adaptation, instruction tuning, and local deployment under realistic compute constraints.
claims.evidence: Cohere Labs Tiny Aya is an open weights research release of a pretrained 3.35 billion parameter model optimized for efficient, strong, and balanced multilingual representation across 70+ languages...
Tiny Aya supports a context length of 8K & 8K output length.
